title: MPG123 x64 port issue

labels.name: category:port-bug
labels.description: The issue is with a library, which is something the port should already support

body:
Building the x86 version works fine, but the x64-windows version fails to build. The vc solution that is used does not contain a build target for x64. Opening the solution in VS(2015) and adding a x64 target, then building in VS works fine, but vcpkg does not perform this. Bulding on Windows 7 x64, en-US locale, VS2015 Update 3.

Log files attached.
[build-x64-windows-rel-out.txt](https://github.com/Microsoft/vcpkg/files/776997/build-x64-windows-rel-out.txt)
